Mod.Name: More Girls
Mod.Author: 清明葬花祭|lapismind
Mod.Description: Original characters: a milk seller, a fortune teller, a green-cloak girl heading for the tower, and nine new visitors in 0.1.3 (vampire, elf, dark elf, mummy, angel, zombie, wandering swordswoman, cheerleader, ninja), and in 0.2.0 six more (magical girl, idol, oni girl, slime, Miss Christmas, succubus), a Keepsake Album for the keepsakes your visitors leave, and the Spirit Anomaly item to help you meet them; 0.2.1 adds the goddess; 0.2.2 adds the fairy; 0.2.3 lets you leaf through the idol's photos. Explore them yourself. Works on its own; All Girls is not required.
